tabernacle-baptist-church-king-george.assessment: Tabernacle Baptist Church of King George is an Independent Fundamental Baptist church that has served King George County since Pastor Davis arrived in 1977. IFB churches are strongly conservative: KJV Bible, male-only pastoral leadership, traditional worship, and a high commitment to biblical authority. Military families have noted the warm welcome and traditional culture. For Moop's priorities (biblical patriarchy, anti-drift theology), this is a strong alignment. IFB churches can sometimes trend toward legalism, but the core doctrinal commitments align well. Recommend investigation.

tabernacle-church-norfolk.assessment: Tabernacle Church of Norfolk is a long-established non-denominational evangelical congregation on Granby Street in Norfolk. Senior Pastor Kenny Bryant has led since 2007, trained at Columbia International University (a strong evangelical/missions institution). Tab's heritage goes back to 1930s Norfolk and the church has built meaningful community roots in Hampton Roads. The church's stated mission — helping people in Hampton Roads discover their story in God's global purpose — reflects an evangelical Great Commission orientation. Key unknowns requiring investigation: statement of faith on Scripture and soteriology, gender/elder policy, preaching style (expository vs. topical). Tab is large enough to have men's and kids' ministry infrastructure. Worth visiting for men in the Norfolk area as a starting point.
